tool_args.rationale: All five pilot responses are positive and measured at H ≤ 0.48. The slow-horizon probe directly tests whether adaptation overtakes the fast, sink-modulated response near H = 20.4 and supplies the long-horizon data needed to fit the proposed law.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon law now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five short-horizon rows cannot reliably separate the slow adaptation amplitude from its time constant, which matters for forecasting at H = 20.4.
Finer trajectory sampling does not directly test the long-horizon reversal.
The auxiliary measurement does not resolve the slow adaptation ambiguity.
